|date=[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]<ref name="Date">Using the text of ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', it is possible to place the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] nineteen days after the start of the novel, and the [[Battle of Esfandia]] (and thus the end of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]'') two months prior to the start of ''The Unifying Force''. The Recapture of Coruscant occurs in 64:6 per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', and by working backwards, at the very least the Battle of Esfandia must fall in 29 ABY. ''The Final Prophecy'' also places its events as more than two years after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], which occurs in 62:4. Thus, ''The Final Prophecy'', which occurs between ''Reunion'' and ''The Unifying Force'', must fall in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], despite ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''{{'s}} placement of it in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref>

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Galactic Alliance '''retook''' the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]].
